content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Gumroad payhip

Sovereign commerce infrastructure is a complete digital commerce stack you own outright. It’s not hosted on someone else’s servers. It’s not dependent on someone else’s payment processor. It’s deployed on open infrastructure like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Payments are processed directly on-chain via NOWPayments—300+ cryptocurrencies, 0.5% fee, no KYC. Orders are stored in Supabase or Google Sheets. Files are delivered via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. The backend logic runs on Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. After deployment, COREMERCH has no access. You own the code, the data, the process. This is infrastructure sovereignty. It’s the opposite of renting platforms like Gumroad or Payhip. Those platforms exclude you because their payment processors exclude you. Sovereign infrastructure bypasses this entirely. It’s built for creators in regions where financial exclusion is a fact of life. It’s not a workaround. It’s a permanent alternative.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The stack is modular. Start with hosting: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Both are free and globally distributed. The backend logic is handled by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Workers are serverless functions that run on Cloudflare’s edge network. Apps Script is simpler but works for basic use cases. Orders are stored in Supabase (a Firebase alternative) or Google Sheets. Supabase is more scalable but requires setup. Google Sheets is plug-and-play. File delivery uses Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Both are reliable and cheap. Payments are processed via NOWPayments. The buyer sends crypto to your wallet. NOWPayments verifies the transaction on-chain and fires a webhook to your backend. The backend checks the payment, logs the order, and sends the download link. The entire process is automatic. No manual intervention. No platform fees. No buyer accounts required. The architecture is designed to be lightweight, fast, and fully owned by you.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This is built for digital creators in regions where Stripe, PayPal, and other payment processors are unavailable or severely restricted. Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Ethiopia, Venezuela, Zimbabwe, Cameroon, Tanzania, Philippines—these are the primary regions. If you sell ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, software, or any digital product, this is for you. The problem isn’t just payment processing. It’s data ownership. It’s platform dependency. It’s the risk of being shut down or locked out. Sovereign commerce infrastructure solves all three. You own the code. You own the data. You own the process. This isn’t a solution for people who want to rent platforms. It’s for creators who want to own their infrastructure. It’s for creators who understand that financial exclusion requires permanent alternatives, not temporary workarounds.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure is not a workaround. It’s a permanent alternative to platforms that exclude you.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Hosting: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Both are free, fast, and globally distributed. Backend: Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Workers are more powerful but require setup. Apps Script is simpler. Database: Supabase or Google Sheets. Supabase is scalable but has a learning curve. Google Sheets is immediate. File storage: Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Both are reliable and cost-effective. Payments: NOWPayments. 300+ cryptocurrencies, 0.5% fee, no KYC. Recommended networks: BSC, Solana, TRON—transaction fees under $0.10. The components are chosen for their reliability, cost, and ease of use. They’re designed to work together seamlessly. For example, Cloudflare Workers can directly query Supabase and trigger file downloads from R2. Google Apps Script can integrate with Google Sheets and Drive. NOWPayments’ webhooks integrate with both Workers and Apps Script. The stack is modular. You can swap components as needed. But the core architecture remains the same. It’s built to be flexible, scalable, and fully owned by you.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start with the Complete Builder Kit ($197). It includes all 6 blueprints, all 7 templates, and instant download. The blueprints cover every component of the stack—hosting, backend, database, file storage, payments. The templates are pre-configured for common use cases. Deploy Stack 01 (GitHub Pages + Apps Script + NOWPayments) in 48 hours. Load 3 products. Test end-to-end. Scale to Stack 02 (Cloudflare Pages + Workers + Supabase + NOWPayments) when ready. The kit includes a scaling playbook and a NOWPayments integration guide. If you prefer to build from scratch, start with the Sovereign Blueprint ($47). It includes full documentation, source code, and step-by-step instructions. Either way, you’ll own the infrastructure. No platform fees. No subscriptions. Lifetime access. This is how you stop renting and start owning. This is how you build a permanent alternative to Gumroad and Payhip. This is sovereign commerce infrastructure.

Integrate payments: NOWPayments. 300+ cryptocurrencies, 0.5% fee, no KYC. 6. Test end-to-end: Load a product, process a payment, deliver the file. 7. Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this if I’m not a developer?

Yes. The Complete Builder Kit includes pre-configured templates and step-by-step guides. You don’t need to write code from scratch. The templates are designed for non-developers. Deploy Stack 01 in 48 hours with minimal setup.
What if I want to switch components later?

The stack is modular. You can swap components as needed. For example, you can start with Google Sheets and later switch to Supabase for scaling. The blueprints and templates are designed to be flexible.
How do I handle customer support?

The stack includes automatic order processing and file delivery. For additional support, you can integrate email or chat tools. The Edge Commerce Stack includes SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration for reliable email delivery.
What cryptocurrencies should I accept?
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. For low fees, recommend BSC, Solana, or TRON—transaction fees under $0.10. You can also accept Bitcoin or Ethereum, but fees may be higher.
What happens after deployment?

After deployment, you own the entire stack. COREMERCH has no access. You manage orders, payments, and file delivery. The stack is designed to be fully autonomous. No ongoing fees. No subscriptions. Lifetime access.
